title: Mandatory and Voluntary Disclosures: Dynamic Interactions

scopes.description: The theoretical paper material represented in this release: the online appendix of analytic proofs and derivations for Sections 3–5 and a preference extension. This work item contains the appendix only; it has no executable entry point, and the main article context referenced by some derivations is outside the package.

issues.description: The frozen package inventory contains only the supplementary online appendix. Its contents provide substantive analytic proofs and derivations, including implicit threshold/fixed-point relations and first- and second-best investment arguments, but no runnable program or numerical algorithm. The proofs also reference article equations and Appendix C outside this release, so the complete article-level workflow cannot be established from this package alone. This is a release/workflow limitation, not evidence that observed empirical data are required.

actions.description: Manually verify the analytic derivations supplied in the appendix; there is no code or empirical input to execute.
steps: Use the paper’s stated theoretical assumptions and definitions to review the supplied proofs and derivations, including the threshold/fixed-point argument in Lemma 7 and equations (A23)–(A24), the Proposition 2 investment argument, and the Section 5 comparative statics.
Treat G, V1, V2, probability distributions and parameters as theoretical model objects, not as empirical input files; no numerical solver procedure or observed dataset is specified in this appendix.
Consult the article text for referenced definitions/equations such as (A13) and Appendix C equation (A18), then record any missing premise or mismatch.
validation: A reviewer confirms the appendix derivations follow from the paper’s definitions and assumptions, including the referenced main-text equations.
